text_block_list.text:
(Running while in high spirits has taught
me
something.)
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
...I'm still not good enough. I have to
keep
running more, and more...
text_block_list.name: Манхэттен Кафе

text_block_list.text:
I want to win. The hero always wins in
the end!
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text:
(Both of them are tenacious and never
try to
mask their own ambitions.)
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
(That's what makes them strong and
allows them
to take the final step toward
victory.)
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
(I want to best them, even as they strive
for their
own version of what is right, and
become number
one.)
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
(I want to become number one in this
"ultimate
era" and show my parents my
success!)
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
There has been a request to feature me
in an
article?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I tell her how her unbridled fighting
spirit caught
a reporter's attention,
leading to a request for an
interview.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
The tentative title for it is "A Flash in the
Ultimate Era"!

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I quite like this clever play on
words.
However...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I do not intend to be a mere "flash," but
a brilliant
light that will shine on to the
very end.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Once I've done what I need to do, I'm
setting my
sights on retirement.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Somehow, it feels like the "end" she has
chosen is
drawing near.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: ...Let's go all-out for the autumn Tenno!

text_block_list.text: Finally, the moment to finish what I set out to achieve has come. I will emerge victorious from the autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I want to ask what her plans will be after
that, but
the sheer determination
blazing from Eishin
Flash's eyes stops me
in my tracks.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
